ingredients.name: bananas, a little over-ripe is best

steps.instruction: Spray a 1 1/2 pound loaf pan with baking spray.
Sift together 2 cups of flour, 3 teaspoons of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Cream 1/2 cup of butter, 1 cup of sugar and 2 eggs on medium speed.
steps.spoken: In the bowl of a stand mixer, cream 1/2 cup of butter, 1 cup of sugar and 2 eggs together on medium speed.

steps.instruction: Add 2 bananas and 1 teaspoon of lemon juice and mix until creamy.
Add the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Turn the mixer off and scrape down the sides.
Mix on medium speed for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of chopped pecans and mix for about 20 seconds.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
